name: Solomon USDv (Legacy)
oneLiner: USDV is Solomon Labs's synthetic dollar on Solana backed by Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral perp margin, with no permissionless public redemption rail.
collateral: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin used by Solomon Labs to back USDv
pegMechanism: USDv targets $1 through Solomon-managed strategy collateral, market liquidity, and approved/whitelisted participant redemption into USDC against a small documented protocol reserve buffer; no permissionless public holder redemption rail is disclosed

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Solomon's official launch history says USDv operated through a year-long live beta before its November 2025 public introduction, and describes the yield engine as a spot-long, perpetual-short basis trade across major cryptoassets. The issuer's current site independently describes USDv as operating live since late 2024 across Treasuries and delta-neutral strategies, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral classification and a conservative Q4 2024 implementation date, stored at its range end (2024-12).

sources.label: Solomon official introduction and year-long beta disclosure

proofOfReserves.provider: Solomon legacy protocol-data API (historical): issuer-reported Ceffu strategy and reserve components through the 2026-08-28 validity point, with a material portion of protocol TVL unmapped. The endpoint's protocol TVL headline now equals the replacement Chancery USDv mint's on-chain supply, so it no longer describes this legacy mint and the last reviewed composition is served as curated data. Replacement USDv reserve documentation does not establish the backing of this legacy mint.

notices.title: Legacy USDv wind-down
notices.message: This profile tracks the original Solomon USDv mint, which remains outstanding. Solomon's wind-down announcement set October 16, 2026 as the end of the legacy front end and support, and October 9 as the sUSDv unstaking-request deadline; those published dates have elapsed. Historical August 8 partial reserve itemization does not establish complete hedge coverage, venue margin, first-loss support or whole-book concentration. Those arithmetic proxies are not measured losses. The replacement USDv uses a different mint and reserve model, with no automatic conversion. Legacy rewards ended August 27.

notices.title: Partial reserve coverage
notices.message: At the September 14, 2026 reserve observation, the issuer API identified about 18.6% of reported protocol TVL; 81.4% remained unmapped. From the September 20, 2026 data cut the legacy protocol-data endpoint itemizes only vestigial components (Ceffu custody below $100, empty vault and reserve fund) while its protocol TVL headline equals the replacement USDv mint's on-chain supply, so live reserve tracking was parked on September 27, 2026 rather than attributing the replacement token's supply to this legacy mint; the curated composition below is the last reviewed snapshot. Exchange hedge notional and mirrored custody balances cannot be added as separate backing to fill that gap. The tracked legacy mint uses a Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral strategy; documentation for the replacement USDv does not establish this token's reserve composition.

obituary.epitaph: An 18-month beta retired behind its successor
obituary.obituary: Solomon Labs began an orderly wind-down of the original USDv and sUSDv system in preparation for the public launch of the new USDv. Legacy rewards ended and the final distribution occurred on August 27, 2026, the sUSDv unstaking-request deadline was October 9, 2026, and the legacy front end and support ended on October 16, 2026. The two tokens are separate with no automatic conversion: holders exit legacy USDv into USDC through the Meteora USDv/USDC pool, then acquire the new USDv. The basis positions are being closed and the legacy programs deprecated. About 1.51M USDv remained outstanding at capture; Pharos freezes the original mint as an archived legacy asset and continues to track the replacement mint separately.
obituary.sourceLabel: Solomon Labs: Winding Down the Original USDv
